title: HIV: Z21, B20 or R75
question: Assign the ICD-10-CM code for the patient's HIV status (only that code).
note:
Chief Complaint
Follow-up on recent lab work.

HPI
Pt is an 83 y.o. female presenting for follow-up of laboratory results. Pt reports feeling well today and denies any new acute concerns or symptoms. Recent HIV screening result was returned as indeterminate. Pt is aware that the result is inconclusive at this time. Confirmatory testing has been ordered and is currently pending. No diagnosis has been made.

Medication List
Multivitamin daily.

Exam
General: Well-appearing, alert, and oriented x3.
Vitals: BP 128/78, HR 72, RR 16, Temp 98.6F, SpO2 98% on RA.
Heart: RRR, no murmurs, rubs, or gallops.
Lungs: CTAB, no wheezes or rales.
Abdomen: Soft, non-tender, no masses.
Extremities: WNL.

Assessment
1. Indeterminate HIV screening result.

Plan
1. Await results of pending confirmatory testing.
2. Follow up in 2 weeks to review results and determine next steps.

Electronically signed,
P. O'Brien, PA-C
05/14/2026
explanations: Inconclusive HIV test without a confirmed diagnosis: R75 (no HCC). Code only confirmed HIV.

distractors.why: HIV is not confirmed; Z21 would add HCC 1.
